_comment: DPWH unit cost rates in PHP. Cost = rate × length(m) × width(m). Edit values here, then commit and push — dashboard auto-reloads on page refresh. Keys are TitleCase to match normalized condition + surface values. Cost is computed only for segments that are FULLY INSPECTED (all 4 fields valid: r_con, s_type, r_length, r_width). Roads with any missing field show '—' in the cost column and are excluded from totals.
